newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - San Leandro USD, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Education Code Section 15146, that the Board of Supervisors of the County of Alameda, California invites bids for the purchase of $15,500,000 aggregate principal amount of San Leandro Unified School District (County of Alameda, California) General Obligation Bonds, Election of 1997, Series A. Bids will be received on
at 9:00 a.m., at the Office of Jones Hall, A Professional Corporation, Four Embarcadero Center, 19th Floor, San

Francisco, California 94111; provided, that the District reserves the right to postpone or change the sale date upon 24 hours notice delivered via Munifacts, and the sale will be awarded by the Deputy Superintendent of the District within twenty-four (24) hours. Further information,

including copies of the preliminary Official Statement, Official Notice of Sale and form of Bid Proposal may be obtained from Kelling, Northcross &Nobriga, Inc., 1333 Broadway, Suite 1000, Oakland, California 94612 (telephone (510) 839-8200). Dated: June 23, 1997.
